drafted_from: tool:notice-messages-on-this-mac's own row (its words, its read-messages capability, its one wake) and the imessage-chat-database leaf's tests over a SQLite file with the Messages tables; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Tell my engine each iMessage and text message that reaches this Mac, the moment it arrives, without sending anything". It switches on tool:notice-messages-on-this-mac's wake keep-noticing-one-source on your Mac with one waiter naming imessage-chat-database.mjs, and each message then arrives at your engine as a something-changed fact at place message, for example {"where":"imessage","place":"message","change":"added","key":"iMessage;-;+15555550101/9F1C2A7E-0001","by":"+15555550101"}.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it tells your engine facts, and the workflows that hear them keep the rows.
instructions: 1. Give the app that runs your engine on this Mac Full Disk Access: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access. macOS lets no program read Messages without it.
2. Grant tool:notice-messages-on-this-mac the read-messages capability at your engine's grants door; a run without the grant is refused before it starts.

3. Switch the wake on with your own waiter: wake:switch {tool: tool:notice-messages-on-this-mac, id: keep-noticing-one-source, on: true, input: {waiters: [one waiter with mechanism_leaf imessage-chat-database.mjs]}} (the worked example shows the waiter). history_since tells messages from that time on when it first starts; without it, only messages from then on.

4. Read what arrives: each message, edit and unsend is one something-changed fact (where imessage, place message, change added, changed or removed) with the sender in by and in after.from. A Mac that refuses the database is told once at place access with the setting to change.
5. It only reads. To send an iMessage, use the iMessage connection (tools/bring-in-new-items-from-this-computer/computer/connections/imessage.mjs), never this tool.

worked_examples.title: Tell the engine each iMessage on this Mac
worked_examples.ask: Tell my engine each iMessage and text message that reaches this Mac, the moment it arrives, without sending anything

waiters.why: The person's iMessage and text messages on their own Mac, read only: each message, edit and unsend told as a something-changed fact the moment Messages writes it, with kinds ["seed"] so the tree's chooser takes it (Nov 20 2026). Messages from Nov 20 00:00 CST on are told on the first start.
